save_active_memory.description: Creates a new active memory record or updates an existing one when `id` is provided.
rules: Use to create or update active memory!
Update: include `id` of an existing record. Use the exact AM-xxxxxx ID for main memory or SUB-AM-xxxxxx for temporary child memory. A child may update only its own records.
Every JSON key other than `id`, `conditions` and runtime-owned metadata is a custom field; can create maximum 3 custom fields. Do not supply owner_subtask_agent_id or subtask_memory_label.
